_comment: An angler of the Watermen and Anglers' Guild (v0.100.0; an Angler since v0.100.1, user: her middle name is her living), who keeps the book for the Guild's fishing contests (game/contests.py). The Guild and its surname, Waters, are the user's; every line here is a PLACEHOLDER by the assistant. {contest}: the contest on now, or when the next ones are.

variants: Mind the edge, {calling}. The bank's soft here.
You've the look of someone with a fish to weigh.
Another Hunter on the bank. The river's always glad of the company.

choices.text: Weigh my fish for the contest.
Why do you run the contests?

rules.text: One kind of fish, one water. Catch it there while the contest's on, bring it here and I'll weigh it. You keep the fish, I keep the number. When it's over, the heaviest wins. Half the Guild's anglers will be out, and some of your Hunters too. There's the Holiday Contest in the four Pulses after every Duel, and a weigh-in at the start of most Reckons for the city river.

why.text: Someone has to, and I'm on the bank more than anyone. I fish for my living, same as half the Guild. The other half would weigh their own catch with a thumb on the scale. So the book's mine. If you want your name in it, it's me you see.
